title: Not The Best
text: Not The Best. I have three different air purifiers; all based on the size of the rooms. This is the least effective unit. I purchased this for my small apartment bathroom. My building is over 60 years old and the AC and heating ducts have never been cleaned and by design can not be cleaned. Every time the AC or heat kicks on dust particles come out of the vent and all over the sink, toilet and tub. So, I though this would help. But, it is useless. With the bathroom door closed, running 24/7 this unit does not have enough draw power to pull in anything. Even sitting on my vanity that should optimize this unit. If you put a tissue by the side vent holes it barely holds a tissue against the unit; on high power. So, you can see it is not effective in 50 square feet or less because it can not circulate the needed  draw power to be effective. Personnaly it is not a good investment for small areas.

product_metadata.title: hOmeLabs 4-in-1 Compact Air Purifier - Quietly Ionizes and Purifies Air to Reduce Odors and Particles from the Air
